detail.longDescription: A few days ago, my fitness app congratulated me on a "great week of activity" with a poetic recap of where I "crushed it." I had spent most of that week visiting family, moving from the couch to the kitchen to the guest bedroom at the speed of continental drift. The app took my step counts, clearly rounded to the nearest thousand, and phrased them generously. Once you start noticing those AI quips, it's hard to stop; and it's not just on your fitness apps.
